correctness.rationale: The infinite construction is not inferred from the finite verification. Each listed operation is a boundary-ear insertion and therefore preserves maximal outerplanarity while changing exactly the two endpoint degrees and adding one degree-two vertex. Starting from the published \(18k+2\) ladder counts, substituting each fixed residue template yields the displayed degree-count deltas and hence the exact largest three-consecutive-degree window \(8k+b_r\) for every \(k\ge1\); the symbolic dependence on \(k\) is affine and the unused high-degree windows remain smaller. Explicit triangulations cover orders 14–19. For orders 5–13 the verifier's recursive decomposition by the triangle incident to one boundary edge is exhaustive, reproduces the Catalan counts, and gives exact minima. The verifier was read completely and confirms all finite support claims.
